thread:
zoe: Planning note 1: We need a clear migration cadence for the 'Sparrow' family. Customers want predictable windows + a non-disruptive migration path. Thoughts on gates?
omar: From infra: require bench parity + staged traffic shift. Gate checklist idea: bench pass, cost-impact <= +15%, canary stability 72h, customer opt-in window.
mei: ML bench items: embedding recall @K20 >= 0.90, generation factuality error <= 2.5% on the QA suite, and token-efficiency delta <= 3% vs pinned baseline. Prefer aggregated MRR for rerank tasks.
dan: Pin tiers we should support for GA:
- trial-pin: 7d (self-serve)
- managed-pin: 45d (ops-reviewed)
- contract-pin: 120d (paid)
Contract-pin implies an explicit migration calendar and a priced reserve.
polly: Pricing/finance: we need to surface reserved-capacity uplift for each tier. Rough uplift: trial 0%, managed +15%, contract +30%. We'll model a per-month add-on + per-token uplift.
zoe: Migration fallback policy: if canary error_rate spikes >0.8% absolute or p95 latency regresses >20% for >1h, auto-roll to previous stable and notify. Ops to document.
omar: Ops action: I'll add telemetry dims (pin_tier, migration_id, canary_bucket) and a dashboard for regressions. Also need retention of per-request traces for 90d for contract pins.
mei: Also request we add adversarial prompt slice to bench harness and a compulsory hallucination audit. I'll provide dataset refs and expected pass thresholds.
dan: Launch checklist (short): bench report, pricing appendix, canary runbook, customer comms template, legal addendum for contract pins.
polly: Finance will produce a short pricing table by EOD Thu, need expected monthly volume per pilot.
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: deploy-sparrow-v2 -> 2025-01-15T22:30Z; CI gated by bench-pass.
zoe: OK, decision owners: omar (ops telemetry + runbook), mei (bench harness + datasets), polly (pricing), dan (contracts wording). Will reconvene after price table. :white_check_mark:
